desc: Street sign in front of the west gate of RIKEN Wako Campus, in Wakō City, Saitama Prefecture, Japan.  The street is dubbed "The Nihonium Street".

desc: RIBF Building in RIKEN Wako Campus, in Wakō City, Saitama Prefecture, Japan.  Radioactive Isotope Beam Factory (RIBF) is housed underground of the RIBF Building.

title: File:RIKEN 160cm Cyclotron Electromagnet P4213465.jpg
desc: Electromagnet used for 160cm Cyclotron of RIKEN, displayed in RIKEN Wako Campus, in Wakō, Saitama, Japan.  The cyclotron was commissioned in 1966, and decommissioned in 1990.
